title: After jhp lands, name pi-durable in the cloud profiles and CloudRule.Harnesses
description:
Tick 4uj's description says the cloud profiles' runner and the boot env's TICKS_HARNESS should say pi-durable once the pi-CLI path is deleted (jhp), but jhp's own description names only 'the herdr/subprocess pi-CLI profiles' — no open tick's text owns flipping profiles-cloudflare-sandbox's runner from "pi" to "pi-durable", and that flip must also admit the name in profile.CloudRule.Harnesses (internal/profile/cloudworker.go, today ["pi"]) or every cloud role is refused at start as not reaching Workers AI. Worth a tick (or a line in jhp) so the end state 4uj's description names is not left to whoever notices next.
evidence: profiles-cloudflare-sandbox/implement-tick.json:6 (runner "pi"); internal/profile/cloudworker.go:58 (Harnesses ["pi"]); image/common.sh:210 (unknown harness kind dies — why it cannot flip before jhp); .tick/issues/jhp.json description names herdr/subprocess profiles only
